question: Patanjali is well known for the compilation of :
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yoga Sutra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Patanjali** is an ancient Indian sage who is traditionally credited with authoring the Yoga Sutra, an important collection of aphorisms on yoga practice.
 
• The **Yoga Sutra** is a foundational text of classical yoga philosophy and practice.
 
• The compilation is divided into four chapters: **Samadhi Pada, Sadhana Pada, Vibhuti Pada, and Kaivalya Pada**, each addressing different aspects of yoga.
 
• The **Yoga Sutra** outlines the eight limbs of yoga (Ashtanga Yoga) which are Yama, Niyama, Asana, Pranayama, Pratyahara, Dharana, Dhyana, and Samadhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ayurveda**

 
 
• Ayurveda is an ancient system of medicine that originated in India over 3,000 years ago.
 
• It focuses on maintaining balance in the body through diet, herbal treatment, and yogic breathing.
 
• Key texts of Ayurveda include the Charaka Samhita, Sushruta Samhita, and Ashtanga Hridaya.
 
 
 
• **Brahmasutra**
 
 
• The Brahmasutra, also known as Vedanta Sutra, is a key philosophical text in the Vedanta school of Hindu philosophy.
 
• It is attributed to the sage Vyasa and is composed of 555 aphorisms that systematically expound Vedantic teachings.
 
• The Brahmasutra is one of the three canonical texts (Prasthanatrayi) of the Vedanta school, the other two being the Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita.
 
 
 
• **Panchatantra**
 
 
• The Panchatantra is an ancient Indian collection of interrelated animal fables in Sanskrit verse and prose.
 
• It was written by Vishnu Sharma and is intended as a guide for political and social conduct.
 
• The stories are divided into five books, each focusing on a particular aspect of governance and human behavior.
